Beginning in November 2019, the Discharger began sending a small portion of its biosolids to the Lystek Organic Material Recovery Center located at the Fairfield Suisun Sewer District wastewater treatment plant in Fairfield, California ... for incorporation into Lystek’s biosolids -derived liquid fertilizer.
